questions.stem: A 45-year-old man is brought to the emergency department after being found in a state of partial suspension with a rope around his neck. The medical team suspects hanging as the cause of death. During the autopsy, the forensic pathologist pays particular attention to the hyoid bone. The most likely finding in the hyoid bone in a case of hanging is a fracture at which of the following locations?
questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old man is brought to the emergency department after being found in a state of partial suspension with a rope around his neck. The medical team suspects hanging as the cause of death. During the autopsy, the forensic pathologist pays particular attention to the hyoid bone. The most likely finding in the hyoid bone in a case of hanging is a fracture at which of the following locations?

options.label: A
options.text: Junction of the outer one-third and inner two-thirds of the greater cornu

options.label: B
options.text: Junction of the outer two-thirds and inner one-third of the greater cornu
